sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
The tests now pass with your original command, `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. It runs 2 tests and both pass.

There were two problems:
1. `tests/` had no `__init__.py`, so unittest refused it as a start directory.
2. `ledgerlite` lives under `src/` and wasn't importable.

I added `tests/__init__.py`, which puts `src/` on `sys.path`. That fixes both problems, and I changed nothing else.
